debtor_role.description: Which debtor of the unit paid the transfer.

site_id.description: Site that owns the statement item.

unit_id.description: Unit the item is assigned to; must belong to site_id.

NewPerson.description: Person fields accepted when creating a role-free card.

PersonCard.description: A concise person card for directory and picker results.

PersonCardResponse.description: Full person card response, including the person's unit history.

PersonEligibility.description: Whether a person can be used for a requested role in a unit.

code.description: Stable reason code when the person is not eligible.

PersonLoginState.description: Login state visible to a site manager.

PersonMutationResponse.description: Result returned after creating or editing a person card.

PersonRef.description: A reference to an existing person card or a draft card to create atomically.

oneOf.description: Create a new card and use it for the requested action.

PersonRole.description: Roles currently associated with a person card.

PersonSearchContext.description: Supported contexts for picker eligibility checks.

PersonSearchItem.description: A card result plus its role eligibility for the supplied search context.

PersonSearchQuery.description: Query parameters for a scoped person picker search.

PersonUnitRelation.description: One historical or active role held by the person in a unit.

assigned_unit_id.description: Unit a manager assigned an unmatched item to.

matched_unit_id.description: Unit found by an automatic matching rule.

UpdatePersonRequest.description: Update contact details using optimistic version checking.

bearerAuth.description: JWT Access Token obtained from `/api/v1/auth/login`. Pass as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

idempotencyKey.description: Unique UUID to safely retry non-idempotent write operations without duplicate effects.
idempotencyKey.name: idempotency-key

requestId.description: Distributed tracing and request correlation identifier.
requestId.name: x-request-id

supportGrant.description: Emergency or privileged support grant session token.
supportGrant.name: x-sitepulse-support-grant

info.description: High-performance multi-tenant residential and community management API built with Rust, Axum, and PostgreSQL. Complies with statutory Turkish Condominium Law (KMK - Kat Mülkiyeti Kanunu), Personal Data Protection Law (KVKK), virtual IBAN automated reconciliation, and double-entry financial ledger standards.
